Kaleshwaram water-crisis blame ran through the whole fortnight.

Internal Congress friction (BC-leader lathicharge) added to the pressure.

insights: The worst fortnight of the three: the 'blood for farmers' / 'belt treatment' remark became a self-inflicted crisis with apology demands from every direction.
Negativity (about 47% of his sample) was concentrated and event-driven, unlike June's diffuse civic grumbling.
His strongest counter was the 'economic terrorist' Kaleshwaram-failure framing and the debate challenge to KCR.
Corruption/#acb jibes and internal Congress friction (BC-leader lathicharge) compounded the damage.
Recovery hinges on closing the 'blood remark' episode and moving Kaleshwaram to the NDSA/CWC restoration facts.
